b1-16-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Peaceful Place
b1-16-01.scenario: You are Carlos. In Budapest, Meg asks you what the place where you grew up is like. It was a village next to a lake, with a forest nearby.
b1-16-01.prompt: Describe your village to Meg using a relative clause.
cues: Say what kind of place it is
Add a fact about the forest or the lake
b1-16-01.target: Es un pueblo donde hay un bosque muy tranquilo cerca del lago.
b1-16-01.english: It is a village where there is a very peaceful forest near the lake.
b1-16-01.canDo: I can describe natural environments and environmental features.

b1-16-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Fewer Trees
b1-16-02.scenario: You are Meg. You walk with Carlos through a park near your flat in Budapest, and he asks if it has changed since you arrived.
b1-16-02.prompt: Tell Carlos how the park has changed.
cues: Say what there used to be
b1-16-02.target: Ha cambiado mucho: antes había más árboles, pero ahora hay menos.
b1-16-02.english: It has changed a lot: there used to be more trees, but now there are fewer.
b1-16-02.canDo: I can describe environmental change from past to present.

b1-16-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Saving Water at the Office
b1-16-03.scenario: You are Carlos. At your office in Budapest, a colleague asks what the company should do about water.
b1-16-03.prompt: Say what is necessary and who has to act.
b1-16-03.target: Es necesario que reduzcamos el consumo de agua en la oficina.
b1-16-03.english: It is necessary that we reduce water consumption in the office.
b1-16-03.canDo: I can discuss what environmental action is necessary.

b1-16-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Is There Less Water?
b1-16-04.scenario: You are Meg. A classmate at your university in Budapest asks why the river is so low this year.
b1-16-04.prompt: Give the cause and the consequence.
b1-16-04.target: Hay menos agua porque ha habido una sequía; por eso, debemos actuar.
b1-16-04.english: There is less water because there has been a drought; therefore, we must act.
b1-16-04.canDo: I can explain environmental causes and consequences.

b1-16-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Youngest Cub
b1-16-05.scenario: You are Meg. You have just read a story about coati cubs and two children, and you tell Carlos what the youngest cub did.
b1-16-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what the youngest cub did and why.
b1-16-05.target: El cachorro bajó a la granja porque tenía hambre y quería huevos.
b1-16-05.english: The cub went down to the farm because he was hungry and wanted eggs.
b1-16-05.canDo: I can describe an environmental problem and propose a solution.

b1-16-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Problem and Solution
b1-16-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks you what the biggest environmental problem is and what to do about it.
b1-16-consolidation.prompt: Name the problem, the cause and a solution.
cues: Name the problem and its cause
b1-16-consolidation.target: La contaminación aumenta porque producimos demasiados residuos; por eso, es necesario que reciclemos más.
b1-16-consolidation.english: Pollution increases because we produce too much waste; therefore, it is necessary that we recycle more.
